questions.question: Believers were taught to put off their former way of life. What is it called?
Believers are taught to put on a new self. Who is this new self created to be like?
A man who had been stealing was told to work with his own hands. What reason was he given?

answers.text: To have something to share with the one in need
To pay back everyone he ever stole from
To earn back his good name around town

questions.question: Believers were told to forgive each other. How were they told to forgive?

answers.text: Just as in Christ God forgave them
As each one confesses his sin
Seven times and then no more
